newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: ASSIDOMAN TO ANNOUNCE NEW CZECH PROJECT.
newsitem.headline: ASSIDOMAN TO ANNOUNCE NEW CZECH PROJECT.

text.p: The Swedish paper group Assidoman AB will announce a new packaging project in the Czech Republic, a spokesman said on Tuesday.

In a statement, a public relations spokesman for Assidoman and the Czech government-funded investment promotion agency Czechinvest said a new project involving the Swedish company's subsidiary Assidoman Packaging in the Czech Republic would be disclosed at a news conference on Monday.

The private Czech news agency CTI recently reported that Assidoman Packaging was one of several international companies considering the construction of a plant in an industrial park near the western Czech city of Plzen.

Czechinvest early this year was involved in attracting Japanese electronics group Matsushita to build a 66 million plant to make Panasonic television sets at the new Borska Pole industrial park in Plzen.
